claude.performance_metric: Total assets down ~25% ($6.39bn→$4.80bn 2010-2014); swung to net income by 2013-2014; 87 properties sold (~$1.24bn) since 2012; NYSE-listed going concern, no divestiture/bankruptcy
claude.rationale: The slice documents a going-concern REIT that renamed, listed on the NYSE, deleveraged via a disposition program (87 properties sold ~$1.24bn), and swung from net losses to net income by 2013-2014, with no documented disruption at the product/process interface — hence p4_pathway=0. Likewise, no documented operations-vs-organization fracture (culture/management/people conflict against integration) appears anywhere in the realized 2010-2014 record, so p5_pathway=0. The portfolio repositioning and eventual return to acquisitions read as an orderly, successful stabilization rather than interface breakdown.

grok.performance_metric: no full divestiture; ~25% asset decline, 87 props sold ~$1.24bn, return to profitability
grok.rationale: The slice documents an intentional multi-year portfolio repositioning (87 properties sold since 2012 for ~$1.24bn, then selective acquisitions) and a swing from net losses to net income by 2013-2014, with the entity continuing as a going-concern NYSE-listed REIT; no realized product/process incoherence is described. Likewise, no fracture at the process/organization interface (operations vs people/management/culture) is documented in the 2010-2014 record.

openai.performance_metric: 87 properties sold for approximately $1.24 billion since 2012
openai.rationale: The realized 2010-2014 record documents portfolio repositioning, including 87 property sales followed by 15 targeted acquisitions, but reports no acquired-product/operating-process incoherence. It also documents a swing from net losses to profits and continued operation as a public going concern, with no reported fracture between operations and people, management, or culture.
